summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K to report a Securities Exchange Agreement to acquire a 52% controlling stake in Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. in two stages. Stage 1 (46% stake) closes in 45–60 days for ~$15.48M in VisionWave stock; Stage 2 (additional 6%) contingent on a milestone for ~$2.02M in stock. Total consideration is $17.5M in stock plus up to $3M in management equity. VisionWave gains board control. A value protection mechanism preserves 65% of economic value of issued shares over two years. The non-US filing is mapped to an 8-K for a material definitive agreement. Watch for milestone achievement and stock consideration valuation.
